svg.title: Ampersand B, pixel-fit end mark for 17 px text, fit B: 13 px tall, 13 wide. Its top row sits on the capitals' top row and its bowl and tail on the baseline, as a typeface sits its round letters at text sizes. Set it with vertical-align 0 px, half an em after the period. Drawn on the pixel grid, one outline (DR-142, stage B). Treatment D for Prussian: one color, White
